scope: Retain and serialize DXFRW Underlay entity callbacks with their typed PDF/DGN/DWF definition callbacks and canonical named-object dictionary ownership edges.

behavior: The converter adapter retains Underlay entities with their import generation and captures definitions keyed by generation plus handle.

The generic bounded object graph recognizes typed Underlay definition targets and validates their owner before the Underlay-specific closure validates entity kind, canonical root dictionary, complete membership, unique definition identity, and ownership.

Strict DXF output remaps and emits selected definitions and entities only after their rooted dictionary graph closes; the serializer binds definition handles and maps entity group 340 references through the same handle plan.

validationProfile.source: Generated locally in memory by the focused adapter control; no external DWG/DXF fixture is used or committed.
validationProfile.readback: Fresh typed import checks each canonical root name, child dictionary owner and key, definition handle/kind/filename/sheet, entity reference, placement, scale, rotation, contrast, fade, and clip boundaries.
validationProfile.failureRetry: For each of a missing definition and a mismatched entity/definition kind, the focused control verifies strict export refusal and preservation of a pre-existing destination sentinel, restores the graph, and verifies successful export retry using the same adapter.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; four version/encoding cells, three Underlay kinds, readback, two atomic refusal cases, and a corrected same-adapter retry after each refusal.
validation.fixturePolicy: The test authors records in memory and uses temporary output files. No test drawing fixture was added.

limitations: This is generated transport evidence only. It does not establish physical producer breadth, native PDF/DGN/DWF interpretation, whole-document conversion, or 3D semantic support.
P8 remains OPEN for LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, intended 3D consumers, native Linux/Windows FreeCAD, ABI, packaging, performance, and release gates. No support claim is promoted.
